描述_EN: a number kilns in different regions made the type of wares we now categorize as cizhou. their products are linked by shared design characteristics, for example, this jar’s stoneware body is decorated with a white slip (a diluted white clay which gives a consistent ground colour) over the surface. a teardrop formation of iron-brown glaze embellishes the surface, a technique used in many kilns across northern china at the time. contrary to the famed imperial wares of the song period made for the very elite, cizhou wares were popular wares, made for every day use. this jar is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the song dynasty (960-1279).
描述_ZN: 不同地区的一些窑厂生产了我们现在归类为贵州的那种器皿。 他们的产品是由共同的设计特征联系在一起的，例如，这个罐子的石器主体在表面上装饰有白滑（一种稀释的白色粘土，使地面颜色一致）。 铁褐色釉面形成的水滴点缀着表面，这是当时中国北方许多窑场使用的技术。 与宋代为精英阶层制作的著名的御用器物相反，慈禧器物是大众器物，为日常使用而制作。 这个罐子是Cizhou ware的一个例子，Cizhou ware是宋代（960-1279）期间在中国北部制造的一种陶瓷类型。
